SESSION	create temporary view nt1 as select * from values
SESSION	create temporary view nt2 as select * from values
READ	SELECT * FROM nt1 natural join nt2 where udf(k) = "one"
READ	SELECT * FROM nt1 natural left join nt2 where k <> udf("") order by v1, v2
READ	SELECT * FROM nt1 natural right join nt2 where udf(k) <> udf("") order by v1, v2
READ	SELECT udf(count(*)) FROM nt1 natural full outer join nt2
